# Safe trading: quote, cap, confirm

**Buy and sell on Solana with quotes, dry runs, SOL caps and a person's confirmation on every trade. Non-custodial.**

Trades Solana coins through Claudia without giving up custody or control — quote first, dry run, hard SOL caps, and a human confirmation for every buy or sell. Covers the online Trade MCP flow (quote → prepare_trade → useclaudia.xyz/confirm link valid 2 minutes → the person signs in their own wallet → get_trade_status), the claudia CLI (claudia quote / buy / sell with --dry-run, --yes, max-sol-per-trade and max-sol-per-day caps), the local MCP server (CLAUDIA_MCP_ALLOW_TRADES, confirm set to true, hard caps), Claudia Local's propose-and-confirm flow, and SDK code (which has no caps of its own). Use whenever an agent or person wants to buy, sell, size a trade, set or change spending caps, or let an AI app touch trading. Includes a read-only preflight script and cap presets. Not financial advice; never promises returns.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/safe-trading.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/safe-trading.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/safe-trading.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/safe-trading.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill safe-trading`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `safe-trading.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/safe-trading`.
